edges.dependent: LTE Protocol Stacks and Radio Access Network
edges.rationale: Understanding the protocol layering and the radio access network requires first knowing the LTE network elements (base stations, edge/core split) and the data/control plane separation that the protocol stacks implement.

edges.prerequisite: LTE Protocol Stacks and Radio Access Network
edges.dependent: LTE Network Attachment and Power Management
edges.rationale: Network attachment is carried out via the control-plane protocol stack (registration signaling with mobility-management entities), so the protocol stack must be understood first.

edges.dependent: LTE Network Attachment and Power Management
edges.rationale: Attaching to the network involves specific architectural components (gateways, mobility-management elements), so knowledge of the architecture is needed to describe the attachment procedure.
Discussing how carrier networks interconnect into a global system presupposes understanding the internal structure of a single carrier's LTE network (core, gateways, edge).
5G is best understood as an evolution relative to 4G LTE (cell density, spectrum, spectral efficiency), so the 4G baseline architecture is a prerequisite for appreciating what 5G changes.
